_comment: District 6 (GDD §4.1 chain order). Prereq verified in data/districts/district_gas_station.tres: powered_by = [&"park"] (NOT hospital, NOT the linear chain order). Like school, gas_station is a LEAF of the power graph — no district's tres lists it in powered_by (industrial takes warehouses+police) — flagged in docs/CONTENT_DISTRICT_GAS_STATION.md, not a content-side fix. Threat roster (scripts/enemies/enemy_pool.gd): hunter, shadow, crawler — hunter LEADS here, so the park's noise-discipline lesson is raised to a hard rule: this district's economy is fuel and fire, both of which are loud. Themed loot canon (district_loot.gd BY_DISTRICT): gas_canister, battery, scrap, bottle. No blueprint (BLUEPRINTS = residential/park/police/warehouses). Story doc canon: doc_scavenger (the scavenger's list: mirrors, toys, switches). Puzzle canon: puzzle_system.gd fuse_gas_station (reward 125 coins, power_stage 2). Repair-part guarantee mirrors district_loot.gd REPAIR_PARTS (2x cable/fuse/transistor). All item ids verified against data/items/*.tres (41 ids, 2026-09).

fixed_spawns.reason: Guarantee: cable for PARTIAL. Grid-crew leftovers at the yard cage, unlocked (the crew was here, gas_station_note_03).
Guarantee: fuse for STREETS. Spare pump fuses in the kiosk drawer — this district's puzzle is literally fuse_gas_station.
Guarantee: transistor for FULL, in the locked service bay; opened by gas_station_fix_key_01 — no lockpick required (R1).
Service-bay key under the till, where a shift manager leaves it. Reachable in DARK with zero tools.
Themed guarantee (BY_DISTRICT): the tanker apron always pays out fuel — the reason to come here at all.
Bottles on the shop shelf; with fuel and fabric they are the molotov economy, without handing out finished weapons in DARK.
Camp rags: the third molotov ingredient, and the camp must feel inhabited even at DARK.
Ready-made defense cache in a car boot on the slip road; STREETS only (R2).
Battery top-up on arrival from the park road; the forecourt is the safe pocket.

rules: R1: In DARK, fixed_spawns alone must cover the repair chain (>=2 cable, >=2 fuse, >=2 transistor); the service-bay key (gas_station_fix_key_01) sits in an unlocked till drawer, so the transistors are reachable with zero lockpicks and zero rolled loot.

R2: Rolled loot never includes stage-gated items early: table lookup uses the CURRENT DistrictData.Stage only. Finished molotovs enter rolls at PARTIAL; in DARK the player gets ingredients (bottle + fabric + gas_canister), never the weapon.
R3: Fixed spawns are one-time per save; rolls are per-container with container_modifiers on qty.
R4: No firearms in gas_station (molotov/firework/noise_bomb remain the ceiling). gunpowder appears from PARTIAL as a crafting material only.

R5: Noise economy, hunter-led: the hunter hunts running sound (park canon, gas_station_note_03). The open forecourt and slip road are fast, loud and rich (car_trunk 1.2, fuel_locker 1.4); the wash bay and shop are slow, quiet and poor. Gravel is a noise surface (`gas_station_gravel_crunch.ogg`) — sprinting across the forecourt must cost.
R6: Camp and tanker caches must not roll empty — both are scripted caches, not RNG (mirrors park's keeper shed, school's shelter, hospital's pharmacy).

R7: Fire discipline is content-level, not just flavour: no fixed spawn places an open-flame item inside the pump island, the tanker apron or the underground-tank zone. Molotovs live in the car boot on the slip road (gas_station_fix_defense_01) and nowhere else.
R8: No blueprint spawns in gas_station (district_loot.gd BLUEPRINTS canon).
